topic: Getting the Wrong Dish at a Sit-Down

script.title: THE WRONG DISH
script.story_hook: A diner receives the completely wrong dinner plate.
script.intro_zh: 食客上了一盤完全錯誤的晚餐。
script.welcome_en: Hey there, welcome back! Today the kitchen sends the wrong dish.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎回來！今天廚房上錯了一道菜。
script.outro: That's our scene today! Enjoy your next meal.
script.outro_zh: 今天的場景就到這裡！祝你用餐愉快。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat after me, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 請跟著我，一句一句重讀。

script.char_b_description: a lanky young man in his early twenties with sandy blond hair in a messy fringe, wearing a white waiter shirt with a black bow tie and a folded napkin on his arm, wincing apologetically
script.youtube_title: 【🍽️上錯菜實況英文】「這不是我才點的」怎麼客氣說？🙋換菜・等待・道謝句型✨｜Wrong Dish English
script.youtube_title_en: "This Isn't What I Ordered" — Getting the Wrong Dish
script.youtube_description:
菜上錯了，怎麼用英文客氣又有效地跟服務生說？這集從「這不是我才點的」開始，練習核對點單、說明熟度錯誤、交換盤子、詢問等待時間，還有適時道謝的完整來回。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，下次餐廳出錯你也能從容應對！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
The kitchen sent the wrong plate — how do you say so in English without sounding rude? This episode starts with "This isn't what I ordered" and walks you through checking the order slip, explaining well done versus medium, swapping dishes, asking how long it takes, and thanking your server. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section so the phrases stay with you.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍽️上錯菜英文｜客氣反映・換菜確認・等待時間｜聽完就會應對餐廳失誤｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
餐廳點了全熟牛排，端上來的卻是三分熟，還不是你那盤？
怎麼說才客氣？怎麼問才有效率？

這一集帶大家走進一間週日晚餐時段熱鬧的餐廳，跟著 Helen 太太從一句「excuse me」開始，核對點單、說明錯誤、確認等待時間，最後把一次小失誤變成一趟暖心的用餐體驗。

你會聽到：
🧾 反映與核對：例如「I think this isn't what I ordered.」、「You're right, this one says medium rare.」。
🔄 換菜與時間：例如「Have you taken a bite from it already?」、「Maybe fifteen minutes, is that okay?」。
💛 客氣與道謝：例如「Thank you so much for fixing it.」、「Thanks for your patience!」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把餐廳情境的應對句型唸到順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次上錯菜，別緊張，笑著把你的需求說完吧！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a steak plate while calling the waiter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I think this isn't what I ordered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjus mi aɪ θɪŋk ðɪs ˈɪzənt wʌt aɪ ˈɔrdərd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我覺得這盤好像不是我點的那道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sorry! Let me see your order slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈsɑri lɛt mi si jɔr ˈɔrdər slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉！我看一下您的點單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked for the steak, well done, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt fər ðə steɪk wɛl dʌn raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我要的是全熟牛排，就在這單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right, this one says medium rare.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr raɪt ðɪs wʌn sɛz ˈmɛdiəm rɛr/
dialogue.zh: 您說得對，這張寫的是三分熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And honestly, it's not even my dish, ha!
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈɑnəstli ɪts nɑt ˈivən maɪ dɪʃ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 而且說實話，這盤甚至不是我的菜，哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's on me, table six got your steak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑn mi ˈteɪbəl sɪks ɡɑt jɔr steɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的錯，六號桌拿到您的牛排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, at least theirs is working out fine!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl æt list ðɛrz ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ aʊt faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，至少人家那桌吃得開心！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have you taken a bite from it already?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ˈteɪkən ə baɪt frʌm ɪt ɔˈlɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 請問您吃過了嗎？我是說這盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one, it looked too good to resist.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn ɪt lʊk tə ɡʊd tə rɪˈzɪst/
dialogue.zh: 就吃了一口，它看起來實在太誘人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it! I'll have a fresh one out soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪl hæv ə frɛʃ wʌn aʊt sun/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！我馬上請廚房出一份新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will that take, roughly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe fifteen minutes, is that okay?
dialogue.zh: 大概十五分鐘，可以接受嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works, thank you so much for fixing it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks θæŋk ju sɑˈmʌʧ fər ˈfɪksɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以的，非常感謝你幫忙處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I grab you some bread meanwhile?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡræb ju səm brɛd ˈminˌwaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 等的時候先幫您上點麵包，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, that'd be lovely, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðæd bi ˈlʌvli θæŋk ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. Your steak will be well done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt ʌp jɔr steɪk wɪl bi wɛl dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來。您的牛排會煎到全熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Take your time, I'm in no rush now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt teɪk jɔr taɪm aɪm ɪn noʊ rʌʃ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 完美。不急，我現在沒那麼趕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for your patience! I'll be right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər jɔr ˈpeɪʃəns aɪl bi raɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您的耐心等待！我馬上回來。
